sys_script_client.description: Form message hygiene for x_casemgmt_case (QA finding F14). On load, binds an input/change listener to the four mandatory fields (subject, status, description, requester_name) that calls g_form.clearMessages() when the user edits one, so the stale mandatory-field banner from a refused save is flushed before the next save writes its own. Prevents the accumulated, self-contradicting banners F14 reports (screen claiming Subject is empty while Subject contains text). Cannot erase a freshly written message - the flush happens on user edit, strictly before the next save - so the three verbatim AAP 0.7.4 state-machine banners still surface and still persist across a fresh reload. onLoad rather than onSubmit because the platform's client-side mandatory check aborts the submit before onSubmit client scripts run, and rather than onChange because sys_script_client.field holds a single field while this table has four mandatory fields.
sys_script_client.name: x_casemgmt_case_flush_stale_messages
